facts.value: The core curriculum for this online master’s in UX program focuses on systems engineering, technical communication, design, principles of user experience and more.
You’ll also choose two elective courses that best fit your career aspirations and specialized interests.
Upon graduation, you’ll know how to research user needs, identify criteria for successful products and refine services through usability testing and evaluation methods.
user experience, design research, human-computer interaction, interface design, interaction design, digital visualization design and usability testing
